contract.task_clause:
The appeal to fear involves
Option A: arguing something should be done only because it will make the person doing it feel good
Option B: arguing someone should do something only because of ill will towards someone else
Option C: arguing actions should be taken to avoid exaggerated, unlikely, or irrelevant negative results
Option D: characterizing an opponents position in a way that makes it seem silly
